title: Vine-Crowned Muse
description: A profile portrait of a bald green-skinned woman with closed eyes, her head transforming into swirling blue, purple and yellow liquid-like forms and water droplets. Her body is entwined with dark green vines and foliage, from which multiple small white line-art figures of dancing ballerinas emerge. Two black wolf-like creatures with glowing eyes appear within the foliage against a dark background with a red sun and a faint pagoda silhouette.
prompt: Profile view of a bald woman with green skin and closed eyes, her head exploding into swirling colorful liquid forms in blue, purple and yellow with water droplets. Her body and shoulders are covered in dark twisting vines and leaves. Small white line-art ballerinas and dancers float around her. Two black wolves with glowing eyes emerge from the foliage. Background transitions from light green mist at top to black at bottom, with a red sun containing a small figure and a faint Asian pagoda silhouette in the distance.
